issues.description: results.json check B ('exhaustive search: every 7-vertex triangulated closed surface is an orientable torus ...') and REPORT Method item 3 overstate the search. It covers only complexes in which each vertex pair lies in exactly 2 triangles, i.e. chi = 0. 7-vertex triangulations of the sphere (pentagonal bipyramid) and of RP^2 exist (xc2_e0.py builds both). The numbers 120, one orbit and |Aut| = 42 are correct. The round-1 cross-check reported the same issue, and the rerun left it unfixed.
issues.suggested_fix: Reword as 'every 7-vertex triangulated surface with chi = 0 is an orientable torus (so no 7-vertex Klein bottle exists), and all are relabellings of ours'.

issues.description: The calibration table and headline list use CALIBRATED for rows whose target source is 'SEED §3' (x -> 4x, |<D,C>| = 21, the Weyl turns, and others). PLAN §1 defines CALIBRATED as reproducing a literature target; these are seed claims, and seed_claims already lists them as CONFIRMED. Unfixed since round 1.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark seed-sourced rows CONFIRMED. Keep CALIBRATED for rows with a literature target (LNR characters, ATLAS maxima, A5 reality, p6m).

issues.description: The AMENDED verdict on 'they don't stack into one clean tower' amends an interpretation, not a fact. Every factual clause of the seed sentence is confirmed. The proposed chain G2 ⊃ SU(3)⋊Z2 ⊃ PGL(2,7) ⊃ PSL(2,7) ⊃ F21 is correct and verified here, but its top steps (kappa, PGL(2,7)) swap the Fano families, which is the seed's point.
issues.suggested_fix: Record it as 'facts CONFIRMED; suggested wording refinement'. Keep the chain and state that the family split survives only up to PSL(2,7).

issues.description: Citation: the maximal-subgroup target 'S4, S4, 7:3' is sourced as 'ATLAS; LNR §5 [read]'. LNR §5 gives only the isomorphism types. The two conjugacy classes of S4 rest on ATLAS, which was not read (results.json says 'via SEED §9').
issues.suggested_fix: Source the two-class statement to ATLAS [summary/via SEED] and to the computation itself.

issues.description: results.json gives a plain CONFIRMED to background and literature claims that E0 does not test ('SU(3) is the color group', 'model-builders used both groups'). The REPORT body correctly says 'CONFIRMED with a cited part'.
issues.suggested_fix: Use 'not tested (cited)' or 'CONFIRMED (cited)' consistently in results.json.

issues.description: Unstated assumptions in the original code, none of which changes a result: the subgroup lattice enumerates only 2-generated subgroups (completeness assumed in a comment); PSL(2,7) is identified by 'simple of order 168'; Aut(PSL(2,7)) = PGL(2,7) by the order 336; and the Finding 8 uniqueness relies on LNR's character table. This cross-check supplies each one by computation (join closure, explicit isomorphisms onto PSL(2,F7) and PGL(2,F7), |Aut F21| = 42 and the degree equation).
issues.suggested_fix: Optional: cite the cross-check, or add a short completeness argument to the Limitations section.

summary: All 19 headline quantities agree exactly; no headline number or seed verdict is wrong. The six issues are minor: wording, verdict vocabulary, one citation and undocumented assumptions.
